(iii) Where the complainant alleges any part of the alleged acts, the burden is upon the prosecution to show that the accused committed such a acts, not connected with the alleged commission of the alleged offences. (iv) Where the accused proves that he has committed the alleged offence, he should be discharged by the trial court." (Vide S.P. Changalvaraya Naidu etc. Vs. Mohd. Khalid & Ors.) (1996) 3
